result: Official primary-law authentication gap closed; no forced outcome change.
remainingQuestion: The recovered 2021 Act establishes industrial-food quality control/AMC but does not identify whether a private postal parcel must undergo special advance application or provide foreign certificates, as distinct from routine arrival inspection/release. Separately, for BNIQ Order A/2024/920, whether Article 3 containers/trucks/other rolling international transport covers the air-post parcel, and whether Article 4 non-sale/noncommercial exemption operates automatically through Article 5 or needs BNIQ approval. Organization Order A/2024/1102 Article 3 supplies exemption-approval power, not by itself a universal application duty. Article 6 foreign documents apply if the parcel is covered. A general operative postal/AMC rule can decide this; no bespoke tea ruling is intrinsically necessary.
